name: USS Co., Ltd.
summary: USS Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates and manages used vehicle auction sites in Japan. It operates through three segments: Auto Auction, Purchase and Sale of Used Cars, and Recycling. The Auto Auction segment manages auto auctions for used car dealers and motorcycle auctions for used motorcycle dealers, provides auto auction connection services via dedicated terminals and the internet, offers used car information services, arranges land transport for auctioned vehicles, and provides financial services to auction members.
